dialogueEntries.text: It's your dad who picks you up... you don't know if you're terrified or excited to see him...

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Sorry, bunny. Your mom would’ve picked you up but she got called away for something real quick.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: How was your first day?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: It... was nice, actually...

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Great! Glad to hear.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: So... I saw that guy when I picked you up. What's the deal between you two? Is there something I should know?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: What? No. I just met him today. We're friends.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Today? That's a quick turnaround. Don't you think you should get to know him better before hanging out alone?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Probably, but he's really nice... and we didn't do anything, I swear.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: First off, even if you did, I wouldn't have a problem with it. High school's time to experiment.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: You know, learning things about relationships while things are less serious is important! Just make sure to do it safely-

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Dad. Stop. Talking. We're not dating!

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: I know, I know...

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: I know, I know...

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: So, are you going to Homecoming dance with him, or...?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Dad!

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Ok, ok! I'll stop!

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Nice to see you keeping in touch with Ella and Dina, even after all these years.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Yeah... I suppose...
As you enter the highway, your heart starts to pick up speed...
You don't know why exactly.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: I wanted to ask, what was that about this morning? I've never seen you angry like that.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: I wanted to ask, what was that about this morning? I've never seen you angry like that.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: I really am fine. Sorry for lashing out at you, I didn't mean to.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: I wanted to ask, are you sure you feel better from this morning? You were acting strange for awhile, there.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: I wanted to ask, are you sure you feel better from this morning? You were acting strange for awhile, there.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: I really am fine. We don't have to dwell on it.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: If you're sure... just know that if we ever do something wrong, you can talk to us about it.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Can I ask... are you real?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: I sure feel real... you asked me this same question this morning. I'm right here, bunny. aren't I?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: At this point... I don't know what to believe. Sorry.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: How about this... since today, reality seems to be slipping for you, how about I prove my realness?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: How?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Well... would a fake dad know how you used to run away when I tried to do your hair?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: You would cry and beg your mom to do it, instead.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Or the Spelling Bee in 5th grade, where we spent nights and nights practicing.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: You got every word right in practice. I knew you had it in you to win... but stage fright got to you.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: You were so sad that you lost, but you didn't seem to care much after I got you frozen yogurt.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: And of course, there's the Bunny and the Big Mountain. That was always your favorite book.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: And of course, there's the Bunny and the Big Mountain. That was always your favorite book.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Do you believe me, now?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Do you believe me, now?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: You seem real, but...

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: DAD!

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: What? Bunny, you're hyperventilating. Take deep breaths with me, okay?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: That's it. That's better. What did you see?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: We- we were in this car... you-

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: It's okay, none of it was real, you hear me? I'm right here.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Let's get you to bed. I'll make your favorite tea.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Let's get you to bed. I'll make your favorite tea.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: I do have a small question.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: What is it?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: What is it?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Did you draw something in my sketchbook? There's a sketch in there I don't recognize.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: No, I didn't touch it. I have my own canvases, bunny. Plus, I forget what I draw half the time, too.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: I guess so...

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: I'm glad you're still drawing and playing music. And you're amazing at both.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: I'm happy to see both your mom and I inspired you to take this path.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Have you looked into art and music programs? I've heard there's an arts school that just opened up. You could go every other day.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: That... sounds nice...

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: And thank you, I'll have to do more research on it.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Where did Mom go? You told me she got called away for something.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Her bandmate called her. Something about 'sudden inspiration.' You know how it is.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Oh right, she wanted me to let you know something.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: If you ever want to make your own music, she told me her bandmates already knew a lot about you, and to reach out.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: You could learn a lot from them, you know?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Right, thanks.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Yeah, you're right. I don't know what I was thinking.
He's real enough to you, and isn't that all that matters?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Alright, you know what? I'll make you your favorite tea tonight.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Thanks, dad. I love you.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Love you too, bunny.
